title: fix(expo,cli,router): Carry preloaded modules through from `<script>` to `React.lazy` bailout for `asyncRoutes` (FOUC)

target.summary: Calling importAll() synchronously before maybeLoadBundle() causes async route resolution to crash on native platforms. On Android and iOS, requiring an unbundled module triggers a fatal error via ErrorUtils rather than throwing a catchable error, preventing the split bundle from ever being fetched.
notes: faulty try-catch attempting synchronous importAll() before loading the split bundle
